idea-plugin.name: Antora Live Preview
idea-plugin.description:
A live preview of Antora sites, built with the project's own Antora and served like a dev server. It complements the AsciiDoc plugin.

  • Opens at once and shows the build's progress; pages are rendered when first viewed, so large sites are ready in seconds.
  • Built from the working tree of local content sources, whatever branches the playbook names.
  • Unsaved edits show as you type, without a reload; the preview follows the cursor and the active page.
  • Double-click a block in the preview to jump to its source line.
  • Shown in a tool window, or in the system browser.

Needs Bun or Node, and Antora installed in the project with npm, pnpm, Yarn or Bun.
